preamble: The plan follows the four requirement stems: application bootstrap and HTTP shell, customers API, health probes, and orders API.

Bootstrap owns configuration, shared cache wiring, shipping client construction, global exception mapping, and router mounting. Customers and orders are separate verticals; orders integration assumes customers exist for placement and tier pricing. Health probes assume the shared cache and database infrastructure bootstrap connects.

slices.name: start
brief: Delivers ShopAPI bootstrap: Settings from SHOPAPI_ env and .env, orders-module ShippingClient with httpx, lifespan logging and Redis cache connect with ping and orderly shutdown, FastAPI 1.2.0 with CORS and server-timing middleware, mapped domain errors to 404/409/422/502, mounted health at /health and versioned customers and orders routers with Authed on API routes, and uvicorn serve entry.

Router modules from the other slices must be importable when exercising full mount and serve; until then verify lifespan, middleware, and exception handlers with focused tests and stub routers if needed.

Verified by starting the app (or a test app with the same lifespan and middleware), confirming cache connect and ready log, hitting a route that raises each mapped error shape, and [unknown] for full authed mount behavior until bearer enforcement from customers is wired.

slices.name: customers
brief: Delivers bearer rejection for missing or unknown tokens on customers routes, POST registration with validation and duplicate-email conflict, GET with Redis cache hit/miss/store and disconnected-cache miss behavior, tier promotion with TIERS rules, response mapping, audit logging, and SQLAlchemy commit or rollback per handler outcome.
Assumes Settings, Cache, and global error types from start; REQ-023 also describes the same bearer rules for orders routes, which start wires via Authed on the orders router.

Verified with a valid API token from settings: register and fetch a customer, exercise cache and not-found paths, promote tier including conflict cases, and confirm session commit on success and rollback on raised errors.

slices.name: health
brief: Delivers liveness with database select 1 and cache ping checks, degraded 503 and status body when any check fails, and readiness returning ready true without dependency probes.
Assumes the shared Cache and database engine that start lifespan connects or that tests connect explicitly; the health router is mounted by start at /health.
Verified by GET liveness with Redis and DB up versus down or cache disconnected, and GET readiness always reporting ready.

slices.name: orders
brief: Delivers list and get orders with pagination and filters, place order with catalogue stock and shipping quote rules including retries and surcharges, amend lines on pending orders, state transitions with terminal and invalid-target guards, order caching, and session commit on successful place.

Assumes ShippingClient and Settings from start, an existing customer from customers for placement and tier or bulk discount logic, and bearer enforcement consistent with REQ-023 via start Authed wiring.

Verified end-to-end: place order for a registered customer, list and get with cache behavior, amend pending lines, transition states including cancel with reason, and exercise validation and upstream failure paths [unknown] for full catalogue and zone fixtures.
